entities.name: Protocol configuration options
entities.description: This IE is included when the UE wishes to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events to the network. It is used when extended protocol configuration options are not supported.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE includes the PCO IE to send protocol data to the network.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options not supported
entities.description: Condition where extended protocol configuration options are not supported by the UE or network end-to-end for the PDN connection.

relations.description: UE includes the PCO IE when it wishes to transmit protocol data to the network.
PCO IE is included when extended protocol configuration options are not supported.
